source_rule: Publicly available job ad or procurement text is evidence of technology use or stated sourcing scope, not request for Evercraft services, not confirmation of IBM i release version, not a contact permit.

observations.text: IBM System Administrator at ECHO Incorporated: IBM i AS/400 iSeries, IBM Power Systems, Infor XA ERP, BRMS, SQL Db2, batch job scheduling; coordinate maintenance firmware updates, operations and modernization ERP migration initiatives. Skills advertisement is not proof of planned IBM i 7.4 upgrade or willingness to pay for assessment.

IBM i AS/400 COBOL Systems Engineer / Application Support Specialist. Help strategic migration from IBM i to Hyland OnBase WorkView, data migration planning, system integration and validation; IBM i COBOL CL RPG SQL DB2 batch jobs documentation and backup recovery. The employer is not independently identified and no buying intent is established.

observations.company: Government of Bermuda - Information and Digital Technologies
observations.text: Government of Bermuda request for proposal BDA-CAB-IDT-IBMi-RFP-2026-08: replace end-of-support Power9 environment with Power11 and Power10, infrastructure supply, installation, configuration, migration, testing and commissioning for IBM i AS400 platform; deadline October 16, 2026. This is an infrastructure RFP, not a purchase request for a $250 IBM i 7.4 assessment.
